'''Chris Richard''' (born December 25, 1984) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player. Richard, a [[power forward]], played [[college basketball]] for the [[Florida Gators men's basketball|Florida Gators]]. He has a [[wingspan]] of 7'4½".<ref>[http://www.bullz-eye.com/sports/features/2007/nba_draft-sleepers.htm NBA Draft sleepers<!-- Bot generated title -->]</ref> His role was that of the [[sixth man]] that came off the bench for the Florida Gators national championship men's team during the 2006–07 season. He is a former Mr. Basketball in the [[U.S. state|state]] of [[Florida]] (2002) and scored 8 points to go along with 8 rebounds (5 offensive) in his final game of his college career.<ref>[https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/boxscore?gameId=274000063 Ohio State 75, Florida 84]</ref> He was taken 1st overall in [[2008 NBA Development League draft|2008 D-League draft]] by the [[Oklahoma City Blue#Tulsa 66ers|Tulsa 66ers]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/draft_board_08.html |title=2008 NBA D-League Draft Results |website=[[NBA.com]] |access-date=November 25, 2008 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151105201943/http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/draft_board_08.html |archive-date=November 5, 2015 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In the [[2007–08 NBA season]], Richard played 52 games with the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]]. Richard signed with the [[Chicago Bulls]] during the [[2009–10 NBA season]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.suntimes.com/sports/basketball/bulls/2080188,CST-SPT-bsep03.article |title=Richard signed; Hunter waived |access-date=March 3, 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100306132442/http://www.suntimes.com/sports/basketball/bulls/2080188,CST-SPT-bsep03.article |archive-date=March 6, 2010 |url-status=dead }}</ref> He played 18 regular season games, and was waived on June 30, 2010.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://realgm.com/src_wiretap_archives/67614/20100630/bulls_waive_kurz_richard_to_create_more_cap_space/ |title=Bulls Waive Kurz, Richard To Create More Cap Space |access-date=June 30, 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100703135304/http://www.realgm.com/src_wiretap_archives/67614/20100630/bulls_waive_kurz_richard_to_create_more_cap_space |archive-date=July 3, 2010 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
